blocks.text: Photo from cfo.gov.ph The United States has welcomed more than 50,000 Filipino participants through its Exchange Visitor Program over the past decade, with teachers accounting for one of the largest groups, the Commission on Filipinos Overseas (CFO) said. As more Filipino educators join the program, the agency has reminded them to comply with J-1 visa requirements, including the two-year home-country residency rule that applies to some participants. The reminder was given during a post-arrival orientation seminar organized by the Philippine Consulate General in Chicago for Filipino teachers working in the United States under the exchange program. 2-year residency rule for J-1 […]...
